book.name: Loum
book.title: Loum Poloye Loum sosee mapoo to hogugu tenee

content: Poloye tei telaga odoo mapooemegei di to taka
Esiga ibada omoo Poibe yo Kenekeleya mi mapoo debeli tei telaga odoo dima kulodu dikon tou medee tekepo tolone badoso.

Esiga sobo hagoso nimapoo siboga, Godeeyo odoo oso moodeli egeesee solone, niyo Lodeeyo hu maga yo idoloso yo medee pidi. Bei, goo abo maga yayo a medee pidilone, odoo abo onosee yayo medee diya pidimeleeso.
Osoloso ayo emegei di to Pilisila mapoo osoloso omo Akwila mapoo takee. Bei, diba abolo hodobo Yesu Kelisowo tou teli.

Osoloso diayo mo gie badeli ee medee pidilame, nei diba dala toloso wedilame mopoodoo doloso debeiso. Goo egeesi maga ayo dimapoo diya goomogoso. Osoloso Yu odoonee dia sosee susuga ososee dimapoo diya goomogoso.

Osoloso dia moso ma kulodu howo gisilame mooloogoodoloso debeli odoo dimapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Osoloso ayo gooma odoo Epainetus mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Bei, Asiya mi toowa ee ma kulodu yayo daga malalo Keliso mapoo tei tooso.
Osoloso Meli mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Bei, yayo niba halo tou toowa tooso.

Osoloso mo soosoo Anadolonikus sabolo osoloso Yuniyas mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Bei, diayo abolo hodobo neliga moso ma kulodu debeiso. Egeesi ma kulodu diye di odoo dima kulodu odoo bakadio hagee hu toowa too odoo. A Keliso mapoo tei telega badoboome, daga diba olo tei toloso debeiso.
Osoloso ayo gooma odoo Lodee sabolo hedebe doloso badeli Amipiliyatus mapoo ayo emegei di to takee.
Osoloso ibada odoo ibolo hodobo Kelisowo tou teli odoo hee Ulubanus mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Osoloso ayo gooma odoo Stakus mapoo ayo emegei di to takee.
Osoloso Apeles mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Yayo dala ma kulodu badolone Keliso mapoo tei toloso badebeiso. Osoloso Alistobuluseeyo moso kulodu debeli odoo mapoo ayo emegei di to takee.
Osoloso mo soosoo ma kulodu badeli odoo hee Helodiyon mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Osoloso Nalikisus eyo moso mapoo debeli tei telaga odoo mapoo ayo emegei di to takee.

Osoloso sobo Tulupaina sabolo, osoloso omolo Tuluposa mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Bei, sobo hagee bia oso Lodeeyo tou toowa teliso. Osoloso sobo ayo gooma Pelisis mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Bei, yinosee Lodeeyo tou toowa teliso.
Osoloso Lodeeyo tou medee tekepo teli odoo Lupus mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Osoloso owee mapoo ayo emegei di to takee. Bei, yayo mo wee masi badolone a medee pidimeleeso.
Osoloso ayo emegei di to Asunkilitus, osoloso Pelegon, osoloso Helemes, osoloso Patolobas, osoloso Helemas, osoloso tei telaga odoo dibolo hodobo hedebe deli odoo mapoo takee.
Osoloso Pilologus, osoloso Yuliya, osoloso Neleyus, osoloso obooba, osoloso Olumpas, osoloso tei telaga odoo susuga dibolo hodobo hedebe deli mapoo ayo emegei di to takee.
Esiga niba emegei dolone dee nei hai nei hai dolone ka debee. Osoloso tei telaga odoo Kelisowo sosee susuga hamapoo debeli oso emegei di to nimapoo ka taka.
Poloye hamameedee kokodo taka

Esiga tei telaga odoo emegei, nima kulodu domo pili odoo sabolo, osoloso tei telaga odoo peegoo gido dili odoo ee medee ege. Bei, diayo eligimo silesibulone, tei goo niyo duloso tei too goo sabolo tobuloso koo eligili. Esiga niba dimaga peegoo dooboobigi.
Bei, odoo egee biaso ibada Lodee Kelisoye goomoga goo ee koo dedeli. Esino dieso goomoga goo ee dodomo silone, toso hodolone goo tokenee gooleedele poogoo odoo ee goo tokenee mapoo gido diliso.

Osoloso niyo Lodee mapoo tei toloso yimapoo mesie sabolo sili goo ee, tei telaga odoo susuga oso duloso olo gooleedooso. Esiga goo egeesi maga a diya goomogo. Esino a diya goomogo, niyo goo tekepo talai goo ono gooleedoloso, tokenee goo talai ee gooleedelega poogoloso dabalame.
Osoloso mesie tosibili Godeeye Saitenso kitulugu ee guobigilei koola toobooso, niyo yo dagadilame. Esiga ayo Godee mapoo takooso, ibada Lodee Yesuye niba sooloo dolone pidilame.
Polowo odoo oso Loum odoo mapooemegei di to taka
Abolo tou teli odoo Timoti yinosee emegei di to nimapoo ka taka. Osoloso mo soosoo Lukiyas sabolo, osoloso Yason sabolo, osoloso Sosipate oso diayo emegei di to nimapoo ka taka.
Esiga Telitiyus ayo Polowo to hagee ka hogugu. Ayo Lodeeyo hu maga nimapoo emegei di to ka taka.

Osoloso moso ayo hagee bado eyo ama Gaiyuseeye emegei di to nimapoo ka taka. Moso hageeyo kulodu tei telaga odoo susuga oso howo gisilone debeliso. Osoloso Kolin mi toowa ee ma kulodu molee gibadeli odoo Elastuseeye emegei di to nimapoo ka taka. Osoloso ibada omolo Kuwalituseeye emegei di to nimapoo ka taka.
Poloye to hamameedee taka
Esiga iba Godeeyo hu dokodoo poudoomo. Bei, yayo to tekepo ayo hagee takomo silo to omaga niyo tei too goo omapoo kitulugu tenelai teiba. To tekepo Yesu Kelisowo goo hagee daga hoogoo mada meleeso.

Esino kookaiyo badeli Godeeye to teneeso, to tekepo hagee Godee maga to toloso kokodo takomo silesibili odoo oso booka mapoo hogugulame. Goo egeesi maga to tekepo ee epei olo woola yilige buguso, odoo susuga oso Keliso mapoo tei toloso o to mapoo mesimo silesibilame.
Esiga goo medee gweli Godee hedebe o hu ee Yesu Keliso maga kookaiyo dokodoo osee poudumelee. Goo hagee tei goo.
